headline: Strait of Hormuz: Navigation "Freezes" – Ship Transit Collapses, Markets Await US-Iran Agreement
summary: Ship transits through the Strait of Hormuz have collapsed as markets await an agreement between the US and Iran. Trump said the strait will reopen soon.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil, so transit disruption directly affects crude supply and freight costs.
why_moved: Ship transits through the Strait of Hormuz have collapsed, and the market is waiting on a US-Iran agreement that would reopen the route.
